Name: Saloon Second Floor
Author: ottersqueaks
Description:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/T3tp6frd/About-text.png[/img]

As the name implies, this mod adds a second floor of apartments to the saloon

[b]Mod users [/b]- download and extract to your mods folder and this map will be available
[b]Mod creators[/b] - This is a map for homeless NPCs. If you're interested in making a map patch for your NPC here, don't hesitate to contact me.

[b]Note[/b] - I will expand the map if necessary to accommodate residents.[i] [/i]However, I also highly recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30295]Pelican Valley Loft [/url]as an alternative.
[i]

[/list]Rooms will be first-come first-serve, with more added as they fill. There will be 1 suite for every 2 rooms.


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/G23kbQ5v/Compatibility-text.png[/img]

[b]Expansions [/b]([i]ES, SVE, RSV, etc[/i]) - [b]Yes[/b]! This mod adds one small map patch to the top left hallway. It is fully compatible with all expansions

[b]Recolors [/b]([i]Earthy, Vibrant Pastoral, Elegant, etc[/i]) - [b]Yes[/b]! This mod was made with strictly vanilla assets. That being the case it is natively compatible with the majority of recolors

[b]Note [/b]- if it isn't compatible with a mod please let me know and I will work on a compatibility patch!
